Figure 1. Elucidation of the Taxol (paclitaxel) biosynthetic pathway and Taxol production
in heterologous systems via synthetic biology approaches. (A) Taxol biosynthetic pathway and
mechanism of oxetane ring formation from three recent proposals described in [5] (left), [2,7] (middle), and [6]
(right). (B) Synthetic biology for Taxol biosynthesis and sustainable production. Various metabolic engineering
strategies for Taxol precursor biosynthesis have been implemented in heterologous expression systems such
as Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, some plants, and endophytic fungi. Abbreviations: GGPP,
geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate; T1βH, taxane 1β-hydroxylase; T5αH, taxadiene 5α-hydroxylase; TOT1, taxane
oxetanase 1.
